about: Repositories whose commits do not count toward a Rankistan score, each with the reason and the evidence. A listed repository loses only its own commits, and the developer's other work still counts. To appeal an entry, open an issue at https://github.com/Sudo-Ali-Dev/Rankistan/issues.
